subject: Mutual Action Plan & technical stakeholder handshake — Bluebridge evaluation
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.inference.com>
To: Sara Li <sara.li@bluebridge.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.inference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.inference.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Mutual Action Plan & technical stakeholder handshake — Bluebridge evaluation

Hi Sara — great to meet you on the call earlier. Following our conversation, I wanted to put a short Mutual Action Plan (MAP) draft in the thread and introduce the internal technical leads who will own the evaluation support from Redwood. Our goal is to get Bluebridge to a production-readiness decision within a 6–8 week evaluation window if that still aligns with your timeline.

Key asks from us to get started:
- Confirm primary technical contact for Bluebridge (network, data access, infra constraints)
- Agree high-level 6-week milestones below and any hard dates on your side
- Attach any procurement or security questionnaires we should expect early

Suggested MAP (attached):
1) Week 0: Kickoff + infra readiness check (SE & CE handshake)
2) Week 1–2: Eval workloads + baseline latency/cost measurements
3) Week 3–4: Quality/edge-case validation + prompts/eval sets
4) Week 5–6: Pilot, go/no-go decision, and next-step commercial discussion

Internal introductions (cc’d):
- Aditya Rao — Account Executive, will coordinate commercial and timelines
- Rishi Malhotra — Solutions/ML Engineer, primary tech lead for the eval (model configs, benchmarks)
- Camila Reyes — Customer Success, will run onboarding and evaluation success metrics

Attachments: Bluebridge_MAP_draft.xlsx, evaluation-checklist.pdf

Proposed next step: 30–45 minute technical kickoff this week so Rishi and Mike (your engineering lead) can align on access and baseline tests. I’m happy to coordinate a time.

Thanks — looking forward to running this with you.

—
Mina Haddad
Senior Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
mina.haddad@redwood.inference.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

From: Sara Li <sara.li@bluebridge.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Mike Tran <mike.tran@bluebridge.com>, Anita Bose <anita.b@bluebridge.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan & technical stakeholder handshake — Bluebridge evaluation

On Tue, Dec 1, 2026 at 9:12 AM Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.inference.com> wrote:
> Hi Sara — great to meet you on the call earlier...

Thanks Mina — this is exactly what we need to get moving. Intro'ing our engineering lead: Mike Tran (cc). Mike will run the technical evaluation on our side and owns infra access. Anita (cc) is on procurement and will surface any contract/PO requirements early.

The 6–8 week cadence looks good. We have one constraint: we need a pilot decision before Jan 15 to align internal roadmap commitments. If we can try to compress the schedule slightly that would help.

Mike — can you join a kickoff tomorrow (Dec 2) between 10:00–12:00 PT, or Wednesday (Dec 3) in the afternoon? Also, I’ve attached a short procurement questionnaire Anita flagged.

Attachments: procurement-questions.docx

Best,
Sara Li
Director, Data Products | Bluebridge Analytics
sara.li@bluebridge.com | +1 (650) 555-0890

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.inference.com>
To: Mike Tran <mike.tran@bluebridge.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.inference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.inference.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.inference.com>, Sara Li <sara.li@bluebridge.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 13:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan & technical stakeholder handshake — Bluebridge evaluation

On Tue, Dec 1, 2026 at 11:03 AM Sara Li <sara.li@bluebridge.com> wrote:
> Thanks Mina — this is exactly what we need to get moving....

Hi all — quick technical intro from my side. I’m the SE who will run the benchmarks and help instrument the eval workloads. A few items I’ll need before the kickoff so we can hit the Week 1 baseline:
- Sample payloads: ~1–2 representative request examples (JSON) and typical token lengths
- Expected qps and concurrency targets for the eval (rough numbers are fine)
- Network constraints: are we testing via VPC peering, private link, or over public egress?
- Any redaction/PII rules we should apply to datasets

Proposed kickoff agenda (30–45m):
1) Intros & roles (5m)
2) Access & infra checklist (10m)
3) Walkthrough of MAP milestones + success criteria (10m)
4) Baseline test plan + owners (10m)
5) Action items & schedule (5m)

I can cover the baseline test plan and run an initial throughput/latency pass during Week 1. I’m available tomorrow 10:30–11:30 PT or Wednesday 2:00–4:00 PT. If those don't work, suggest a time and we’ll adapt.

Attachment: evaluation-checklist.pdf (technical checklist extract)

—
Rishi Malhotra
Solutions/ML Engineer | Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.inference.com

From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.inference.com>

Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan & technical stakeholder handshake — Bluebridge evaluation

Perfect — thanks everyone.
Mike/Sara: Let’s lock Wed Dec 3, 2:00–2:30 PM PT for a tight kickoff to run through the checklist Rishi outlined and confirm access. I’ll send a calendar invite shortly and include the MAP draft.

Action owner summary:
- Aditya: coordinate commercial timeline and PO path with Anita
- Rishi: baseline test plan + pre-kickoff checklist (asks above)
- Camila: success metrics & reporting cadence
- Mike: grant infra access and provide sample payloads

If anything changes, flag ASAP. Looking forward to it.

—
